# llm-wiki-jk — Biomedical Knowledge Graph

> An interactive knowledge graph exploring longevity through adrenochrome, autophagy, mitohormesis, and disease prevention. Built from an Obsidian-style biomedical wiki; content is available in English and Traditional Chinese (中文).

## Interactive Graph

- [Graph View](https://graph.johnnykuo.com/): Interactive 3D knowledge-graph explorer of the llm-wiki-jk biomedical wiki, with entity tooltips and an analysis/chat panel (EN / 中文).

## Articles (English)

- [SIRT Disease Atlas](https://graph.johnnykuo.com/pages/sirtuins_disease_complications.html): Sirtuins (SIRT1–SIRT7) in health and disease, examined complication by complication across cancer, metabolic, cardiovascular, and neurodegenerative contexts.
- [SIRT Pleiotropy Explorer](https://graph.johnnykuo.com/pages/sirtuins_pleiotropic_roles.html): The seven mammalian sirtuins as compartmentalized, context-dependent metabolic rheostats in tumor cell metabolism and therapeutic targeting.
- [(Preclinical) Ivermectin × Fenbendazole](https://graph.johnnykuo.com/pages/ivermectin-fenbendazole-anticancer.html): Complementary anticancer mechanisms of ivermectin and fenbendazole and their connections to sirtuin biology (preclinical evidence).
- [(Speculative) Adrenochrome MB/AG Protocol](https://graph.johnnykuo.com/pages/adrenochrome-protocol.html): Interactive explorer of a speculative adrenochrome methylene-blue / ascorbate-glutathione protocol — clearly labeled as speculative, not medical advice.

## Articles (Traditional Chinese / 中文)

- [SIRT 疾病圖譜](https://graph.johnnykuo.com/pages/sirtuins_disease_complications_zh-TW.html): 健康與疾病中的 SIRT，逐併發症檢視。
- [SIRT 多效性探索器](https://graph.johnnykuo.com/pages/sirtuins_pleiotropic_roles_zh-TW.html): 腫瘤代謝與治療中的 SIRT 多效性角色。
- [（臨床前）伊維菌素 × 芬苯達唑](https://graph.johnnykuo.com/pages/ivermectin-fenbendazole-anticancer_zh-TW.html): 互補的抗癌機制與 Sirtuin 連結（臨床前證據）。
- [（推測性）Adrenochrome MB/AG 方案](https://graph.johnnykuo.com/pages/adrenochrome-protocol_zh-TW.html): 互動式解說器 — 推測性方案，非醫療建議。

## Node Analysis (Knowledge Graph)

The graph holds [2,512 concept nodes and 3,649 links](https://graph.johnnykuo.com/), grouped into 371 communities (most small; the largest cluster around the seven mammalian sirtuins). Node importance below is ranked by degree, PageRank (PR), and betweenness centrality.

### Graph statistics
- Nodes: 2,512 · Links: 3,649 · Communities: 371 · All nodes are `concept` type.
- Largest communities by member count: SIRT1 (124), SIRT6 (69), SIRT3 (57), SIRT2 (53), Mitohormesis (43), MOMP (38), COMT (36), Cancer (35), Senescence (33), Resveratrol (33), Adrenochrome (33), Caspase-3 (32), Acid ceramidase (31), SIRT5 (31), Nicotinamide Riboside (30), p53 (30), SIRT7 (29), Val158Met (29).

### Bridge nodes (highest betweenness — connect otherwise-separate clusters)
SIRT1 (0.165) > COMT (0.081) > NF-κB (0.065) > SIRT6 (0.064) > SASP (0.060) > SIRT3 (0.059) > Cancer (0.056) > Aging (0.046) > SIRT2 (0.043) > Oxidative Stress (0.041). These nodes are the highest-leverage points for traversing the graph from one topic cluster to another.
